correctness.rationale: Proof: complete atomic-diagram and first-order type recursion; all witness extensions equal repeat-or-positive-gap splits; a proved induction with gap threshold 2^(r+1) reduces all rank-four inputs to 1024 canonical pairs. Two separately executed direct and symbolic verifiers agreed for independently enumerated finite boundary cases. The infinite theorem follows from the induction, not finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The two landmarks are a natural logical enrichment of classical cycle Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé games. The complete 340-class finite classification for all positive directed arc lengths, explicit normal-form table, and sharp optimal 35-vertex bound are nontrivial structural information not implied by the unmarked total-cycle-size cutoff. The result permits exact bounded-depth model checking on an infinite parameter family using a finite optimal representative atlas.
